Evaluates fire linkage service quality and hazards across 6 system interlock inspection points (alarm, smoke extraction, broadcasting etc.), outputs rectification advice, for fire maintenance and annual inspection.

map.年度检测与故障排查时，用评分快速判断联动是正常、基本正常还是严重故障。: In annual testing and troubleshooting, use the score to judge quickly whether the interlock is normal, basically normal or seriously faulty.

map.评分超过多少算严重故障？: Above what score counts as a serious fault?
map.本工具约定总分 0 为联动正常、≤4 为基本正常、>4 为严重故障（满分 18，: This tool treats a total of 0 as interlock normal, ≤4 as basically normal and >4 as serious fault (out of 18, 0 = all normal). A sub-item ≥2 counts as needing repair.
map.联动检测多久做一次？: How often should interlock inspection be done?
map.通常按消防法规与维保合同，联动控制系统每年至少进行一次全面检测；重大改动或故障修: Under fire codes and the maintenance contract, the interlock control system needs at least one full inspection per year; special re-inspection is also warranted after major modifications or fault repairs, with records kept as evidence.
